heading: About Me
bio:
I'm Guendouzi Mohamed Yaniss, a computer science graduate and accomplished front-end developer with over 5 years of experience. My focus is on utilizing React and Next.js to craft immersive web experiences.

With a strong foundation in computer science, I'm driven to create user-friendly and visually impressive applications. My goal is to continually push the boundaries of web development and contribute meaningful solutions to the digital landscape.
